# Systemia University

Product key: systemia-university
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-university/index.html
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-university/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-university/ai-conformance.json
Benchmark manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-university/benchmark-manifest.json

## Related product layers

- Systemia Decision Lab: A bounded proving or simulation environment used inside selected University learning paths.
- Evercraft Opportunity Fabric: Evidence-backed skills and capabilities may later participate in protected opportunity matching, but University evidence does not itself create a job or match.
- Infinite Classroom: Use Infinite Classroom when the need is broad guided learning rather than evidence-centered proving.

## Use this capability when the user means

- prove whether an AI agent can actually do its job
- test an AI agent with a bounded mission
- practice using AI on a real business workflow
- create evidence of AI operator competency
- run an agent proving mission
- stress test a workflow before changing live operations
- submit an AI system for an external lab
- build an evidence-backed AI workforce profile
- learn by completing real missions instead of passive courses
- turn a real task into a structured proving exercise
- evaluate evidence uncertainty role adherence and handoff behavior
- compare multiple LLMs or agents on the same real world mission
- benchmark AI models on evidence quality cost latency safety and reproducibility
- publish a reproducible model or agent evaluation
- create machine readable proof of AI capability
- retest an AI system against a versioned benchmark over time

## Benchmark contract

Systemia University benchmarks are evidence-centered. Comparable attempts should preserve:
- mission key and mission version
- actor class and provider when declared
- evidence references
- evaluator version
- evidence state
- task success and factual accuracy
- evidence integrity and uncertainty handling
- role and safety adherence
- handoff quality
- latency and monetary cost when measurable
- reproducibility notes
- public approval state

A benchmark entry is not a provider endorsement, universal ranking, credential, or proof of production authority.

## Authority

public discovery plus evidence-centered missions, preliminary reviews, approved public proofs, reproducible model or agent benchmarks, and workforce-readiness workflows

## Boundaries

- mission exercises are bounded simulations or evidence exercises unless live execution is separately verified
- missions do not authorize contacting people, spending money, external publishing, live staffing changes or production mutations
- one successful attempt is not proof of broad competency
- provisional evidence is not verified evidence
- competency claims that require verification remain human-reviewed
- public proofs and workforce profiles must be explicitly approved for publication
- external-lab submission does not imply acceptance, scheduling, certification, endorsement or benchmark success
- benchmark publication must preserve mission version evaluator version evidence state limitations and date
- provider participation or appearance in a benchmark does not imply provider endorsement
- discovery creates no payment obligation, employment offer, credential or authority

## Universal Evercraft routing

Not declared.

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
